category_edits.rationale: Test weaker tied real-item embeddings by reducing the normalization multiplier from 0.75 to 0.70 across all four category models. Preserve the vocabulary-dependent radius and raw exclusive mask vector. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so training and inference remain consistent.

change_summary: Reduce only the tied real-item embedding normalization multiplier to 0.70 for all four BERT4Rec models.
